definitions.explanation: A large Shinto shrine in Shibuya, Tokyo, next to Harajuku, dedicated to Emperor Meiji and Empress Shōken. It stands in a forest planted by volunteers and was completed in 1920. It draws more first-visit worshippers at New Year than any other shrine in Japan.
